Mine Your Own Business


32 vs 32 CTW
Red vs Blue

Map Authors:
{tag=f876b8631ccd4ae2acad8a09e2209e81}
{tag=c1d94f186ea3495a8d1b7d9eaf393f64}
{tag=47b15675a0484e8f863a0cbf86ba22dc}
{tag=63b88dffc6b44e08bd17aae089b12e95}
{tag=282f4bab54bb4e2a83459583c8d533ce}
{tag=3cce00809faa48f982cf64410305822a}

This is a unique CTW, because the lanes are mostly located indoors (inside the mountain). Other than being enclosed, however, the layout is similar to what can be expected from a normal CTW, with some quirks.

In the mountain you can only modify blocks in (& near) the designated tunnel areas. Outside, barriers confine movement to the front lines & spawn, meaning you cannot scale the mountain from the bottom, or go around it to get to or from the spawn.

Pictures:
https://imgur.com/a/f7ne0
